sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment
inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

Each blow down sump is equipped
with two blow down sump pumps per unit, which is vertically mounted submerged P/Ps these
P/Ps discharge the condensate to waste treatment system.
المواصفات الفنية:

Psuc. = 304.8 
 مم ح2O Pديس. = 7.620 Bar T = 105C

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as 
safety helmet, shoes, earplugs etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of pump
motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of
motor.

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات

Standard tool set, 
 adjustable wrench.
Contact thermometer,
مؤشر درجة الحرارة.
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Tighten all 
loose البراغي والتحقق من الاهتزاز المفرط والاستماع إلى الضوضاء غير الطبيعية 
(الاهتزاز المسموح به يصل إلى 4-8 مم/ثانية).

تحقق 
الصحافة تفريغ المضخة.

Check bearing temperature (max 85C) and change the oil if need or change the 
bearing.
